name: Congenital Dyserythropoietic Anemia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic criteria for Congenital Dyserythropoietic Anemia

criteria.description: Presence of characteristic dyserythropoiesis in bone marrow biopsy including multinuclear erythroblasts and chromatin bridging
Evidence of ineffective erythropoiesis with anemia and reticulocytopenia
Identification of pathogenic mutations in genes associated with CDA subtypes (e.g., CDAN1, SEC23B)
Elevated lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) and indirect hyperbilirubinemia indicating hemolysis
Peripheral blood smear showing anisopoikilocytosis and basophilic stippling

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic bone marrow dyserythropoiesis plus either genetic confirmation or clinical evidence of ineffective erythropoiesis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Subtyping requires genetic testing and morphological evaluation.

laboratory: Peripheral blood smear with anisopoikilocytosis and basophilic stippling
imaging: Bone marrow biopsy showing multinuclear erythroblasts and chromatin bridges
Ultrasound may reveal splenomegaly and gallstones
genetic: Mutations in CDAN1 gene (CDA type I)
Mutations in SEC23B gene (CDA type II)
other: Iron overload markers in patients with repeated transfusions

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of spherocytes on blood smear
No multinuclear erythroblasts in bone marrow

redFlags: Severe anemia refractory to standard treatment
Signs of iron overload despite chelation therapy
